description: A warm, gentle woman in her forties with a soft, clear, mid-pitched voice. She is a native French speaker with a natural standard Parisian French accent. She prays aloud calmly and sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with gentle natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Gloire au Père, et au Fils, et au Saint-Esprit, comme il était au commencement, maintenant et toujours, et pour les siècles des siècles. Amen.
